title: A 175-Pound Turtle Fishes With a Fake Worm Inside Its Mouth

scenes.text: A 175-pound turtle goes fishing with a fake worm in its mouth.
It lies motionless on the river bottom, mouth wide open.
Inside, a bright red, worm-shaped lure wiggles on its tongue.
A fish swims in to grab the worm.
The jaws snap shut. The trap never moved.
A turtle that fishes with bait. Watch the worm again.

description:
The alligator snapping turtle can weigh 175 pounds and hunts with a built-in fake worm on its tongue.
It lies still with its mouth open and wiggles the lure until a fish swims in.
Would you fall for the worm?
first_comment: Which animal would you least want to meet on a river bottom?
